parts.name: Frame
parts.Basic_description: The frame of the microwave is made of stainless steel, forming the main structural body that houses all internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity, supports the door, and encloses the electronic and heating components safely.
parts.Movement_description: The frame is fixed and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Door
parts.Basic_description: The door of the microwave is made of tempered glass and plastic, designed to allow visibility inside while maintaining safety.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the cooking chamber, seals the microwave cavity, and prevents radiation leakage when closed.
parts.Movement_description: The door rotates about a hinge to open and close, allowing user access to the interior.
